catalog_policy: Role-based academic composition suggestions. Numeric margins, area shares, and capacities are local heuristics; check the actual rendered content and viewing conditions.

field_semantics.grid: Textual composition instruction, not renderer coordinates.
field_semantics.visual_ratio: Approximate share of usable content area assigned to the primary evidence, excluding title and footer.
field_semantics.max_items: Independently explained blocks or panels; not individual shapes, words, equation symbols, or data samples.

layouts.grid: Title and subtitle above a compact source/authorship region; optional contextual visual to the right.
rules: Identify the paper or talk and distinguish source authors from the presenter.
Use a verified contextual image only when it explains the subject.
Keep affiliations and source metadata readable without competing with the title.

layouts.grid: Section heading with a short route list and a compact reference to the previous question.
rules: State the purpose of the next segment, not an unsupported result.
Retain the same chapter labels and navigation position throughout the deck.
Keep navigation text accessible in the linear reading order.

layouts.grid: Large observed example on the left; bounded research question and context on the right.
rules: Separate the observed problem from the hypothesis offered to explain it.
Put the source beside the motivating example.
Keep the question connected to the evidence the talk will later evaluate.

layouts.grid: Aligned input and target/output regions with condition labels; task definition beneath.
rules: Label inputs, available conditions, and desired outputs explicitly.
Identify whether the displayed target is measured, annotated, simulated, or illustrative.
Preserve sample identity and comparable scale across paired views.

layouts.grid: One horizontal process path; supporting supervision or condition track below; numbered module labels.
rules: Label every major input, transformation, and output.
Distinguish data flow, supervision, and optional branches by connector labels or patterns.
Reuse module names in later detail slides and include a complete static path.

layouts.grid: Small context diagram at the side and enlarged module with one explanation region.
rules: Mark the enlarged module in the overview so the audience keeps its location.
Explain its role before presenting internal details.
Keep variables, tensors, and connector meanings consistent with the overview.

layouts.grid: Equation in a broad central region; aligned symbol definitions and a short interpretation below.
rules: Preserve the source equation and define the symbols used on this page.
State whether an expression is exact, approximate, assumed, or proposed.
Use a separate derivation page when explanation and mathematics no longer fit legibly.

layouts.grid: Primary quantitative comparison above; protocol, caveat, and source in a compact aligned strip below.
rules: Show metric name, units, direction, method identities, and the tested condition.
Keep the title no stronger than the available comparison and uncertainty.
Use direct labels and point to the full result if the view is a selected subset.

layouts.grid: Matched condition table or paired result panels with a shared baseline and takeaway.
rules: Name the component or condition changed and what was held fixed.
Retain the common baseline and evaluation protocol.
Separate measured differences from hypotheses about their mechanism.

layouts.grid: Aligned sample rows and method columns; matched enlargements use explicit crop markers.
rules: Keep method order, sample identity, crop, and display scale consistent.
State how examples were selected and include a source trace.
Label any normalization or registration difference that changes comparison meaning.

layouts.grid: Observed failure on one side; reference view and bounded diagnosis on the other.
rules: Identify the observed defect separately from a proposed explanation.
Show a relevant reference or comparison under labeled conditions.
Connect the failure to a claim boundary or next diagnostic test.

layouts.grid: Labeled comparison matrix with a short statement of the dimensions being compared.
rules: Use explicit, source-supported comparison dimensions.
Keep unknown or unreported entries distinct from absent capabilities.
Provide a source for each compared work and avoid unsupported superiority labels.

layouts.grid: Evidence or untested condition paired with its implication for the current claim.
rules: Distinguish observed limitations from conditions that were not tested.
Explain which conclusion each limitation narrows.
Treat a proposed remedy as future work until evidence verifies it.

layouts.grid: Dated observed outputs on the left; blocker, dependency, and decision on the right.
rules: Separate completed, running, blocked, and planned entries using explicit words.
Attach verification evidence and dates to completed outputs.
End with the concrete decision or action that the displayed state supports.

layouts.grid: Ordered milestones with dependency connectors and a labeled evidence-of-completion column.
rules: Distinguish target dates from observed completion dates.
Name the verification condition for each planned milestone.
Expose unresolved dependencies without implying completion percentages that were not measured.

layouts.grid: Prompt and known quantities in a fixed region; numbered solution states occupy the remaining area.
rules: Give the learner a clear task before the answer.
Label intermediate states so the static handout remains understandable.
State the rule or assumption each transformation uses.

layouts.grid: Short supported conclusions with stable references to evidence slides; one visible boundary statement.
rules: Summarize only what the talk actually established.
Point each conclusion to the evidence already shown.
Keep the central limitation visible when it conditions the conclusion.

layouts.grid: Main discussion question and a compact labeled index to backup evidence.
rules: Use descriptive appendix labels and a usable return route.
Keep necessary conclusions on the main linear path.
Provide static slide references as well as clickable links.
